Status: CANONICAL INITIAL RELEASE
Approved compounds: 28
Atomic roots changed: 0
Generated forms changed: 0
Next authorized gate: Gate 4C — English concept and sense index
Authority and design rule

This bounded release approves only compounds whose graph adds a real compositional intersection beyond every component atom. Each definition has one explicit semantic head; modifiers narrow that head, and open participants use typed slots. Content-derived CMP identifiers are authoritative. English titles are indexing metadata, not compound identity or proof of meaning. Runtime state, contour, register, pitch, and occurrence grammar remain outside lexical compound identity.

Explicit non-approvals and deferrals
• person and core motion entities remain atomic or discourse-level; they are not duplicated as compounds.
• water remains an unresolved vocabulary gap because no canonical atom distinguishes liquid phase or H2O composition.
• food remains an unresolved vocabulary gap because no canonical atom states nutritional suitability or consumption.
• shelter remains an unresolved gap because protection is not entailed by structure plus care.
• home is deferred to Gate 4C because its English senses split across structure, habitual location, social bond, possession, and affect.
• friendship remains a gap: LIF:210 supplies a life-bond but not the social convention of friendship.
• run a program, send a message, and transport require occurrence-level role binding and belong to semantic IR, not one lexical compound.
Validation and boundary

The full project regression passes. Gate 4B passed 16/16 dedicated checks covering content-derived identity, graph connectivity, canonical atom references, semantic boundaries, three-direction scored review, atom-collision discipline, honest gaps, semantic-IR deferrals, authority integration, and atomic immutability. Gate 4B does not authorize the English sense index, etymology layer, semantic IR, executable grammar, renderer, decoder, or translator.
